ns2:section.sectionText: [Expanded title: Audiovisual Materials in Libraries and Archives] LEEP students; Non-LEEP students may enroll on a space-available basis; contact Kathy Painter (painter@illinois.edu). Online and Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. Meets January 30 - March 20. Required on-campus session Saturday, March 1. See section description for 590AV at http://www.lis.illinois.edu/academics/courses/catalog. 2 GR hours. Elective for Graduate Certificate in Special Collections.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to CAS:Lib & Info Sci Online-UIUC or MS:Lib & Inf Sci Online-UIUC.
